cross_horizon_alignment.note: Descriptive alignment only. Horizon disagreement is preserved and has no execution authority.

cycle_4_8w.summary: No evidence-supported 4–8-week cycle direction or action posture. A conditional 21–30-day scenario does not fill the missing longer-window confirmation.

strategic_21_30d.expected_path: First test whether BTC's USD advance holds through a retest; then whether ETH/BTC stabilizes and 30d breadth survives weakness; finally look for—or fail to obtain—90d/365d breadth and settled ETH-flow confirmation. This is a conditional sequence, not a dated rotation forecast.
falsification: The selective-consolidation base case weakens toward the bull case if ETH/BTC strengthens persistently, 30d participation survives pullbacks, and longer-horizon breadth and ETH flows improve together.
It weakens toward the bear case if BTC loses its completed-W40 advance while 30d breadth fades and ETH-relative weakness persists.
Neither scenario is established by a single 30d shadow label or one isolated ETF session.

scenarios.label: BASE
scenarios.thesis: BTC-relative leadership and selective participation persist through volatile consolidation; broad alt rotation remains unconfirmed.

scenarios.label: BULL
scenarios.thesis: USD strength persists, ETH/BTC stabilizes, and pullback-resistant breadth begins to reach the longer rotation horizons.

scenarios.label: BEAR
scenarios.thesis: BTC's advance reverses, short-horizon breadth fades, and persistent ETH weakness turns a retest into broader contraction risk.

strategic_21_30d.summary: Conditional 21–30-day mixed outlook and WAIT posture, not an actionable cycle turn. Analytical scenario weights are not calibrated probabilities; the partially overlapping 4–8-week cycle/action call remains unavailable.

12h.path: Current-state continuation unless the native confirmation or deterioration gate changes state.

168h.path: W40 is an unresolved consolidation with a bounded pullback/retest watch, not a confirmed breakdown or a confirmed broad altseason. Positive W39 closes and settled ETF rows counterbalance deterioration in ETH/BTC, latest proxy breadth, sentiment and spot microstructure. Prospective scenario ranges: BTC $79,500–$89,000; ETH $2,480–$2,880.

72h.path: Short-horizon state is cross-checked against the current weekly regime; transmission must improve before risk moves down-cap.
